title: the WSG damage from heat and cold - the temperature damage and frostbite tables
audit_label: R430 WSG heat and cold pin audit
audit_comment: The heat-and-cold data slice pins Tables 9 and 10 (rules/wsgheat.h, prefix wsh): the 25 temperature damage bands, the frostbite shares and thresholds, the damage and check adjustments, the hypothermia and heatstroke rules; census 354 -> 355.

banner.title: The WSG DAMAGE FROM HEAT AND COLD, R430: the data slice of the heat-and-cold section - Table 9 (the temperature damage to characters) and Table 10 (the frostbite damage to characters) with the adjustment, hypothermia, frostbite and heatstroke prose pins.
banner.provenance: Provenance: the WSG scan (archive.org item pdfy-B3Fz83tZ3TV7zOc8), printed pp. 25-27, cross-checked against the user own copy and the user eye-read of the Table 10 combination rows (the Frostbite Occurs At cells are blank in print).
banner.sentinel: Sentinel: 99 = the printed dash (no Con Check); 0 in Table 10 = blank in print. Table 10 shares pin in sixths (2/3 = 4, 1/3 = 2, 1/2 = 3, all = 6, absent = 0); thresholds only on the single-part rows (Feet 4, Ears 6, Hands 8 pts).

consts.comment: Hypothermia recovery: 1 point per category per hour.

consts.comment: Severely frostbitten hands: the melee penalty lessens to -2.

consts.name: wshFrostHandsTreatTurns

consts.comment: The heatstroke recovery numerator: two-thirds rounded up.

bools.name: wshLeastFavorableAdj

examples.note: the book heatstroke example, part one: protected at 105 degrees takes the max 2 plus the fatigued max 6 = 8
examples.expr: m['wshHeatBandFor'](105) != 21 or m['wshHeatDmgProt'](21) != 2 or m['wshHeatDmgProt'](21) + m['wshFatigMax']() != 8

examples.note: the book example, part two: inactive in the heat subtracts, max 2 minus 1 = 1
the book example, part three: the treatment regains 2/3 of 10 Con points rounded up = 7
examples.expr: m['wshHeatstrokeRegainNum']() * 10 > 3 * 7 or 3 * 7 - 3 >= m['wshHeatstrokeRegainNum']() * 10 or m['wshHeatstrokeRegainNum']() != 2 or m['wshHeatstrokeRegainDen']() != 3

examples.note: the band edges: -60 or lower is band 0 (+14 Con), the tolerable 31-84 is band 16 (all dashes), 120 or higher is band 24
examples.expr: m['wshHeatBandFor'](-60) != 0 or m['wshHeatConUnprot'](0) != 14 or m['wshHeatBandFor'](31) != 16 or m['wshHeatConUnprot'](16) != 99 or m['wshHeatBandFor'](120) != 24 or m['wshHeatDmgProt'](24) != 4

examples.note: the frostbite thresholds: feet 4, ears 6, hands 8; the combination rows are blank
examples.expr: m['wshFrostPts'](0) != 4 or m['wshFrostPts'](1) != 6 or m['wshFrostPts'](2) != 8 or m['wshFrostPts'](3) != 0 or m['wshFrostPts'](6) != 0

examples.note: the book own distribution examples: hands and ears with 3 damage splits 2 ears 1 hands (the ears share listed first carries the leftover)
the Con Check adjustments by level: -1 at 4-6 up to -5 at 16+, no adjustment below 4th
examples.expr: m['wshConAdjL46']() != -1 or m['wshConAdjL79']() != -2 or m['wshConAdjL1012']() != -3 or m['wshConAdjL1315']() != -4 or m['wshConAdjL16']() != -5

table_checks.note: every Table 10 row shares all six sixths among the vulnerable parts
table_checks.expr: m['wshFrostFeetShare'](0) + m['wshFrostEarsShare'](0) + m['wshFrostHandsShare'](0) != 6 or m['wshFrostFeetShare'](4) + m['wshFrostEarsShare'](4) + m['wshFrostHandsShare'](4) != 6 or m['wshFrostFeetShare'](6) + m['wshFrostEarsShare'](6) + m['wshFrostHandsShare'](6) != 6

table_checks.note: a threshold only on the single-part rows: a nonzero threshold means an all-share of 6 (0 whenever the shares sum to 6)
table_checks.expr: m['wshFrostPts'](0) * (6 - m['wshFrostFeetShare'](0) - m['wshFrostEarsShare'](0) - m['wshFrostHandsShare'](0)) + m['wshFrostPts'](2) * (6 - m['wshFrostFeetShare'](2) - m['wshFrostEarsShare'](2) - m['wshFrostHandsShare'](2)) + m['wshFrostPts'](3) * (6 - m['wshFrostFeetShare'](3) - m['wshFrostEarsShare'](3) - m['wshFrostHandsShare'](3)) != 0
